text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Dale Pfau said he raised Vitesse Semiconductor Corp's 1997 earning estimates to $1.18 a share on revenues of $101 million, up from previous estimates of $1.05 a share on revenues of $96 million.
-- set 1998 earnings estimates at $1.50 a share on revenues of $146 million.
-- sets a 12-month target price of $60 a share.
-- sees gross margins moving to the 60 percent to 62 percent range over the next four to six quarters.
-- sees the company showing 10 percent sequential quarterly revenue growth for the "foreseeable" future.
-- Vitesse gained 3-15/16 to 49-3/4 in afternoon trading.
